_comment: Canonical Claude plan/session usage-limit banner phrase fragments (card 115c21e7). ERE-safe on purpose -- no \d, no (?:...) -- so the same strings compile unchanged under bash `grep -E`, Python `re`, and JS/TS RegExp. Provenance: card f085fd44 (session-limit alternative from upstream aefa693; the /upgrade STARTUP HINT is deliberately EXCLUDED -- it matched Claude Code's '/upgrade to increase your usage limit.' hint shown in every fresh idle pane, a 2026-06-30 false positive) plus commit 5fccf4f9 (the interactive limit-modal's other two menu options, 'stop and wait for limit to reset' and 'upgrade your plan', added 2026-07-11). This is the physical source of truth for every consumer EXCEPT src/model-fallback.ts, which keeps its own literal copy (USAGE_LIMIT_FRAGMENTS) for a load-bearing zero-filesystem-dependency reason documented there -- src/__tests__/session-limit-pattern-consistency.test.ts pins the two equal instead. scripts/limit-monitor.sh appends its OWN additional alert-only fragments (rate_limit_error, 429, quota exceeded) on top of this core -- those are intentionally NOT here, because a generic transient rate-limit blip must never trigger a MODEL FALLBACK or a fleet quota-block decision (only a human-facing heads-up alert), a distinction src/model-fallback.ts's own tests pin explicitly. B-hullam (kartya f27c999b, 2026-09-04): az upstream 2026-08-18-i meresebol atveve a heti/session alakok -- 'reached your weekly limit', 'approaching ... weekly limit', 'Session limit reached' --, ahol a detektor nema maradt. Az upstream '(\\w+ )?' szeleskoru joker-tagja SZANDEKOSAN kimaradt: nincs mert string, ami igenyelne, es egy korlatlan szo-joker ennel a detektornal teves modell-visszaminositest okozhat (ugyanaz a hibaosztaly, mint a kihagyott /upgrade startup-hint).
